traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusion: Chedis of Kalinga vs. Chedis of Bundelkhand (Ancient Vedic tribe). Always distinguish by era and geography.
Myth: Kharavela was a Buddhist. Truth: He was a staunch follower and patron of Jainism.
Chronology: Assuming they were contemporary to the Gupta Empire. They are strictly pre-Gupta, post-Mauryan.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in Trikalinga/Kalinga
  • Control over the Eastern Coast
  • Capital: Kalinganagara

Personalities

  • Mahameghavahana (Founder)
  • Kharavela (Greatest King)

Key Dynastic Aspects

  • The Hathigumpha Inscription:
    • Primary source for Kharavela's reign.
    • Prashasti-style record written in Brahmi script and Prakrit language.
    • Describes 13 years of his rule.
  • Religious Policy:
    • Promotion of Jainism.
    • Restoration of the Kalinga Jina idol taken away by the Magadha king (Nanda).
  • Military Might:
    • Kharavela conducted campaigns against the Satavahanas (Satakarni) and the Greeks (Demetrius).
